The '''Flower Market''' was a market in [[Shelkonwa]]'s [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Makrin City]]. The tables owned sound absorbers to make private haggling possible. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] [[Yeeru Chivkyrie|Chivkyrie]], [[Thillis Slanni|Slanni]], [[Ydor Vokkoli|Vokkoli]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Organa]] met [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] [[Administrator/Legends|Administrator]] [[Vilim Disra]] in this place. The goal of this meeting was to find out how [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Barshnis Choard]] intended to make the [[Shelsha sector/Legends|Shelsha sector]] independent. However, Disra left the meeting after Organa had asked him about the number of allies, because he wanted to betray the Rebel members.
